html:
The Gunindiri are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Northern Territory, on the northern edge of the Barkly Tableland, inland from the Gulf of Carpentaria.

Very little is recorded about them. On the map their neighbours are the Wambaya to the south, the Gudanji and Binbinga to the west and north, and the Waanyi to the east. Like them, the Gunindiri lost much of their grassland country to cattle stations from the 1880s on.
sum: The Gunindiri are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Northern Territory, on the northern edge of the Barkly Tableland, inland from the Gulf of Carpentaria.
